target.title: fix: keep OpenClaw control tools available when tool_search misroutes
target.body:
Closes #99464
Related: #99551

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex app-server workers could be told to discover OpenClaw session/control tools through `tool_search`, but `tool_search` could resolve a different connector universe and leave the worker without the OpenClaw delegation/control tools it needed.

## Why This Change Was Made

OpenClaw now keeps the critical control-path dynamic tools, `heartbeat_respond`, `sessions_spawn`, and `sessions_yield`, in the direct Codex tool surface while leaving broad OpenClaw tools deferred/searchable. This preserves Codex-native `spawn_agent` as the recommended Codex-subagent path in developer instructions, but removes the unsafe dependency on a successful deferred search result for OpenClaw/ACP delegation and heartbeat handling.

Codex source inspection for this change used sibling `../codex` at `da4c8ca57d40b074bdc1b5b1218851100150c56b`:

- `codex-rs/app-server/README.md:1557-1566` documents that deferred dynamic functions must be namespaced and are searchable only when `tool_search` is available.
- `codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec_plan.rs:494-536` enables deferred-tool guidance only when the search tool is enabled.
- `codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec_plan.rs:964-984` builds `tool_search` only from planned deferred runtimes with search info.
- `codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/tool_search.rs:74-87` builds the search index from the supplied deferred-tool search infos.

## User Impact

OpenClaw Codex workers keep access to OpenClaw heartbeat and session delegation controls even when deferred `tool_search` is unavailable or returns unrelated connector results. Operators should see fewer fallbacks to expensive raw shell inspection when an OpenClaw worker needs OpenClaw-specific session controls.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tools.test.ts`
  - 81 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.test.ts`
  - 116 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/thread-lifecycle.test.ts`
  - 77 tests passed.
- `git diff --check`
  - Passed.

Notes:

- Initial grouped local Vitest run was stopped after going quiet for local resource safety; the same target files were then run one at a time and passed.
- No raw private worker transcript or session JSONL content is included in this PR.
- AI-assisted change.
